description: Shell script for performance testing of the core.fsmonitor feature in Git. It sets up various conditions to evaluate the performance impact of the fsmonitor feature, including different configurations, integrations with Watchman, and different cache settings. The script automates the setup, execution, and cleanup of a series of performance tests related to file system monitoring.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Initializes trace logging if GIT_PERF_7519_TRACE is set, setting up trace directory and log files.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Stops trace logging by unsetting GIT_TRACE2_PERF if tracing was enabled.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of empty files in a directory.
